question:
Several Pods are running in namespace `survey`. Write two command files. Each file must contain a `kubectl` command, will be executed with `bash <file>`, and must work no matter which namespace is the current default.

1. `/home/candidate/exam/q4/oldest-first.sh`: print only the names of all Pods in namespace `survey`, one per line, sorted by creation time (oldest first). No header and no `pod/` prefix.
2. `/home/candidate/exam/q4/pod-ips.sh`: print all Pods in namespace `survey` using `-o custom-columns` with exactly two columns titled `NAME` (the Pod name) and `POD_IP` (the Pod IP), including the header row.

verification.description: oldest-first.sh prints survey Pod names sorted by creation time
pod-ips.sh prints NAME and POD_IP custom columns for all survey Pods
